prompt: In a vibrant anime style, a bustling mountain campsite unfolds under a clear sky. On the far left, a girl in a yellow raincoat stands beside a silver kettle, her hand resting on its handle as she looks at the steaming spout. Next to her, a blue tent is pitched firmly on the grass, its flap open to reveal a sleeping bag inside. A boy in a green cap sits on a wooden log near the center, holding a marshmallow on a stick over a crackling fire pit. The fire pit, filled with orange flames and grey ash, sits directly in front of him. To his right, a woman in a purple scarf points toward the distant peaks, her arm extended high. Beside her, a brown dog lies calmly on a picnic blanket, watching the flames with interest. A red cooler is placed next to the dog, its lid slightly ajar. In the background, a man in an orange vest hangs a lantern on a tree branch, the light glowing softly against the twilight. Near the tree, a black backpack leans against the trunk, straps dangling loosely. A child in a pink hat reaches for a bag of chips held by a teenager in a denim jacket, who stands near the edge of the clearing. The teenager smiles while handing the snack over. A white cat perches on top of the red cooler, grooming its paw. Behind the group, a large pine tree towers over the scene, its needles detailed and sharp. A hiking boot rests on a rock near the fire, laces untied. A map lies spread out on the picnic blanket, corners weighed down by small stones. There is no snow on the ground. There is no river visible in the frame.
